summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of new 'Carga y Progresión' features in SessionEditor. All features verified working: collapsible panel, auto-calculated metrics (Carga Total, Carga Sesion, NeuroCarga, Zona FC, Zona Fuerza), progression models (Lineal/Ondulada/Bloques/Conjugada), MEV→MAV→MRV volume projection chart, and capacity-specific UI changes (Complejidad slider for coordinacion/equilibrio/agilidad, Zona FC for resistencia, Zona Fuerza for fuerza/potencia).

issues: Console warning: 'button cannot be a descendant of button' - nested button elements in phase header causing hydration errors
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - accessibility issue
Console warning: 'tr cannot be a child of span' and 'span cannot be a child of tbody' - HTML structure issues in DashboardPage table

action_items: Fix nested button elements in SessionEditor phase headers (line ~1282-1301) to resolve hydration errors
Add aria-describedby to DialogContent components for accessibility compliance
Fix HTML structure in DashboardPage table - ensure tr elements are direct children of tbody, not wrapped in span
critical_code_review_comments: CAPACITY_CONFIG correctly maps each capacity to subtipos, unidades, and showComplejidad/showZonas/showDeficit flags
calcMetricas function properly calculates derived values: cargaTotal = vol * int / 100, cargaSesion = ser * vol * int / 100
calcProgresionSemanal correctly projects volume for each week with deload week support
SessionViewPage.js correctly displays new fields (densidad, subtipo, unidadIntensidad, complejidad) in shared link view
All new fields have proper defaults in ACTIVIDAD_INICIAL for backward compatibility

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All Carga y Progresión features verified working

seed_data_creation: None required - used existing TEST Plan Fútbol ATR
